# CI/CD Workflows - Placeholder

## Overview

This directory will contain GitHub Actions workflows for the Trading Anarchy Multi Miner project. 

**Status**: Not yet implemented (Phase 0-1 Bootstrap)

## Planned Workflows (Phase 11 - Issue #14)

The following workflows will be implemented in Phase 11:

### Build & Test Workflow
- Multi-platform builds (Windows, Linux, macOS)
- Unit test execution
- Integration test suite
- Code coverage reporting
- Artifact generation

### Security Scanning
- Dependency vulnerability scanning
- Static code analysis
- Secret detection
- License compliance checking

### Release Workflow
- Automated version tagging
- Release note generation
- Package publishing
- Cross-platform binary distribution

### Documentation
- API documentation generation
- GitHub Pages deployment
- Link checking
- Documentation testing

## Current Phase

During Phase 0-1, we are keeping the initial PR minimal by avoiding incomplete workflow files. This placeholder documents the upcoming CI/CD infrastructure without committing non-functional YAML files.

## Implementation Timeline

CI/CD workflows will be implemented in **Phase 11** as part of issue **#14**. This ensures:
- Stable foundation is established first
- All features are properly testable
- Workflows can be comprehensive and complete

## Development Notes

When implementing workflows in Phase 11:
1. Follow GitHub Actions best practices
2. Include security scanning and compliance checks
3. Support multi-platform development
4. Integrate with package managers and distribution channels
5. Ensure proper secrets management
